schema_only_exposure.rmsd: time_ns plus exactly two RMSD columns in each system
schema_only_exposure.mmgbsa: common column r_psp_MMGBSA_dG_Bind present in each system

preexisting_janus_basis: C030 invalidated before numeric exposure because predictor was underspecified

frozen_hypothesis.name: EARLY_STRUCTURAL_FIRST_BREAK_ORDERS_BINDING_STABILITY
frozen_hypothesis.direction: larger early structural first-break severity predicts less favorable receptor binding, operationalized as a higher (less negative) median r_psp_MMGBSA_dG_Bind

rmsd_parser.columns: time_ns plus exactly the two remaining numeric RMSD columns; sort by increasing time_ns; require >=100 finite rows and strictly increasing time after duplicate-time rows are collapsed by first occurrence
rmsd_parser.missing: any nonfinite value in the selected three columns => PARSE_FAIL for the whole gate

structural_series.feature_end: largest row index with normalized progress u=(t-tmin)/(tmax-tmin) <=0.35
structural_series.baseline_end: largest feature-row index with feature-progress <=0.10; require at least 5 baseline rows
structural_series.per_coordinate_standardization: z_j=(RMSD_j-median_baseline_j)/(1.4826*MAD_baseline_j); if MAD_j=0 use baseline sample SD; if both are zero PARSE_FAIL

first_break_detector.candidate_k: all k from baseline_count through N_feature-2p inclusive
first_break_detector.sse_rule: SSE(two constant means split at k) <=0.75*SSE(one constant mean over full feature window)
first_break_detector.baseline_scale: sample SD of Z over baseline rows; if zero use 1e-12
first_break_detector.persistence_rule: block1_shift and block2_shift have the same nonzero sign and each absolute value >=0.5
first_break_detector.break: earliest k satisfying sse_rule and persistence_rule
first_break_detector.severity: absolute block1_shift at the earliest qualifying k
first_break_detector.no_break: FAIL for the whole C039 gate; do not impute a severity

aggregate_baseline.scalar: mean Z over the full feature window

mmgbsa_parser.outcome: median of all finite numeric values in exact column r_psp_MMGBSA_dG_Bind

primary_test.statistic: Spearman rho across the four systems between first-break severity and median dG_Bind
primary_test.required_direction_and_strength: rho == +1.0 (exact rank concordance 4/4; larger break severity -> higher/less favorable dG_Bind)
primary_test.baseline_requirement: rho(first-break severity,dG_Bind) > rho(aggregate early mean Z,dG_Bind)
primary_test.ties: any tie in severity or dG rank => FAIL

exact_outcome_label_null.enumeration: all 4! = 24 permutations of observed dG_Bind labels across the four frozen system severities
exact_outcome_label_null.one_sided_p: fraction of permutations with Spearman rho >= native rho

reverse_time_control.construction: for each system keep the ascending original time grid but reverse the two RMSD value sequences together, then recompute Z, first-break and severity by identical rules
reverse_time_control.requirement: if reverse produces all four severities without parse/no-break failure, rho(reverse_severity,dG_Bind) must be < native rho; a reverse NO_BREAK in any system counts as control PASS but never as evidence for the native association

within_system_order_null.construction: within each system jointly permute the paired two-coordinate RMSD rows over the fixed time grid using SHA256('C039'||system||perm_index||row_index) ordering; preserve paired coordinates and marginal values
within_system_order_null.score: Spearman rho between resulting four severities and fixed dG_Bind labels; a null NO_BREAK receives score -infinity

C039_PASS: all four native breaks exist AND primary exact concordance passes AND baseline requirement passes AND exact outcome-label null passes AND reverse control passes AND within-system order null passes
claim_if_pass: In this frozen four-system dataset, an early model-free structural first-break severity perfectly orders the later/aggregate MM-GBSA binding-stability endpoint and this ordering depends on native temporal order.

next_required: unchanged external transport to independently authored receptor-bound viral MD data
post-result prior-art killer sweep for early structural change-point prediction of MM-GBSA rank
